terms: Live terms (v2 props): NBA threes / rebounds / assists and NFL receptions / yards / touchdowns and quarterback passing touchdowns / interceptions / completions only, rebounds / threes / assists buy once NBA overs buy on the NBA's own table alone at one past the line (two other sources agreeing also counts), points after the next stoppage + 3 s of clock, NFL 3 s after the next real snap (not a timeout, flag or the same play posting late), NBA rebounds, threes and assists (assists unless an assists bet has lost, which turns assists off) up to $5,000 per market, NFL touchdowns up to $1,500 per market, NFL receiving / rushing yards $1,500 once 15+ past the line, $1,000 at 10+, $500 before, and $500 whenever the game has a minute or less left, everything else $500; rebounds and threes take 98c-or-better stock first and re-fire while it keeps coming back, everything else walks the book from the cheapest ask up to 0.99; after any buy it keeps re-buying at 99c while sellers reload (stops after 10s with no fill, 15 rounds, the market cap, or the moment the stat moves against us or a correction hold starts; an NBA in-game buy is followed on the same rule it fired on); no price floor (an ask of any price up to 0.99 is bought; the dollar caps limit a bad read), a touchdown line needs the second vendor (never ESPN alone), no crowd-bid requirement (the 98c seller is the crowd signal); unders only after the final, box unchanged 75 s on both ESPN views and matched by the second source (Sleeper) whenever it is reporting the game; a cash shortage never stops the night, clinch waits and fires when money returns; no per-game cap, cash floor $500, night pauses after 2 settled losses (every loss texts), no resting bids. NHL goals / assists / points are live one over (a 1+ line fires at 2, only after the game clock has run 3 s past the goal and both ESPN and the NHL API show it, over side in game only, $500 per market); goalie saves stay watch-only. Also watching, never buying (recorded to watchonly_<date>.jsonl; no cash, caps or loss stop touched), watch-only: KXNFLBOTH, KXNFLDSTTD, KXNFLFG, KXNFLLONGREC, KXNFLLONGRSH, KXNFLPASSATT, KXNFLRRYDS, KXNFLRSHATT, KXNFLSFTY, KXNFLTEAMSACK, KXNHLSAVE.
